hacks.name: Edel (EDEL) on Ethereum
hacks.source: DefiLlama Hacks + official team post on X
hacks.description: Attackers stole and sold about $300,000 of EDEL on Ethereum. The team said MEXC and BloFin blocked or sold off the rest of the stolen tokens. Cause not yet published; a full report was promised. This is Edel's second hack in 2026 (the first was June 30, about $403,000, via a price-feed attack).

market_notes: ALERT: EDEL was hacked. About $300,000 of EDEL was stolen and sold on Ethereum. Confirmed by DefiLlama Hacks and an official team post. Cause not yet published. This is Edel's second exploit in 2026 (June 30 price-feed attack, about $403,000).

Bitcoin about $68,900, down about 4%, a 12-week low. ETH about $1,956, SOL about $81.09. The move was market-wide (dollar, rate-hike worries, Nvidia), with about $1.6B of leveraged bets forced closed.
Solrouter (ROUTER) bounced: price about $0.00062 (up about 35%), pools about $59,000 total, main pool about $45,100 — still thin.
SERV about $0.0129 (up about 10%); its main Ethereum pool remained deep at about $943,000. PLUME about $0.0142.
